newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds above support in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds above support in late trading.

text.p: LME copper edged lower in late inter-office trading on Monday, but survived a test of nearby support.
Prices slipped to just under Friday's lows around $2,120 per tonne, pegged as the first support area, but then rebounded to be indicated at $2,127/30 by 1900 GMT.
This compares to an afternoon kerb close of $2,133.
Some analysts said copper would eventually head down to the key $2,000 mark due to a minor head and shoulders formation.
LME stocks are expected to rise by about 2,000 to 3,000 tonnes on Tuesday after three consecutive builds.
Stocks increased by 6,400 tonnes on Friday.
The other metals were little changed in late activity.
